ammonia.reason: Modest amino-acid deamination in long ripening, suppressed by low aw 0.93-0.94 and salt-in-moisture 10.49%.

animal_barnyard.reason: No p-cresol/indole quantified; light rind phenols from Menorcan ripening cellars only.

bitter.reason: Accumulation of hydrophobic bitter peptides from chymosin and lactobacilli peptidases, partly masked by 2.75% salt.

blue_moldy.reason: Low endogenous methyl ketones 2-heptanone 2.0, 2-nonanone 1.1, 2-undecanone 0.4 ug/g dm via fatty-acid beta-oxidation, no Penicillium.

browning.reason: Maillard between residual reducing sugars and lysine on heating, aided by low moisture and 29% protein.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from Lactococcus citrate metabolism largely reduced with age, leaving only milkfat lactones.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Extensive lipolysis: butanoic 48, hexanoic 91, octanoic 53, decanoic 110 mg/kg dm from milk lipase and rennet paste.

creaminess.reason: Low moisture 26.21% and high salt limit aqueous lubrication despite 36.99% fat, FDM 50.13%.

crumbliness.reason: Long-aged low-moisture pH 5.33 matrix fractures via short demineralized para-casein strands.

firmness.reason: Very low moisture 26.21%, MNFS 41.6% with Ca 902 mg/100g cross-linked para-casein network.

floral_honey.reason: No quantified phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol; only trace yeast-derived esters in SDE profile.

fruity.reason: Esterification of free fatty acids with starter ethanol gives ethyl butanoate 0.66, hexanoate 1.5, octanoate 3.3, decanoate 6.6 ug/g dm.

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks 4-methyl/4-ethyloctanoic acids; only slight caprylic/capric waxy sharpness.

malty_nutty.reason: Prolonged proteolysis plus Strecker degradation of Leu/Ile/Val to maltol-like aldehydes and nutty notes.

melt.reason: pH 5.33 rennet gel retains partial casein hydration and 50% FDM flows moderately but aged crosslinks limit flow.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one detected and no surface mold; only faint lipid oxidation.

oil_off.reason: High total fat 36.99% with lipolyzed aged protein network releases free oil on heating.

smoky.reason: No smoking step and no guaiacol reported; oil/paprika-rubbed natural rind only.

sour_vinegar.reason: Mesophilic starter lactic acid ~2% at pH 5.33; no acetic/propanoic accumulation reported.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata rennet curd with no hot-water kneading; no aligned para-casein fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Pasteurized uncooked curd; only trace dimethyl disulfide/trisulfide by log peak area, minimal methionine catabolism.

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted to lactate; faint sweetness from free amino acids, proline and glycerol.

umami.reason: 29.08% protein with extensive rennet/plasmin proteolysis releasing glutamate-rich peptides.
